i prodotti
della Natura

We welcome Horizon Europe partnerships on soil health, circular biomass, water resilience, biodiversity and carbon farming.

At Cana, in southern Tuscany, we manage 22.6 hectares of Inula and Cistus, olive trees, woodland and natural regeneration. Since 2019, agroecological practice has connected land restoration with the farm’s productive development.

Local plant biomass is the starting point for CÍGNULA and INBRUMA dei Carbonari. We seek to characterise these materials and test their soil applications, linking landscape care to viable farm income.

As a practice partner and pilot site, we contribute land, field implementation, biomass processing and soil monitoring. Joint work can assess soil and water responses, carbon, biodiversity, costs and labour under Mediterranean conditions. Spatial visualisation, XR and interactive communication support documentation and knowledge exchange.
